paragraphs.source_en: Tōdō Takatora and Katagiri Katsumoto were appointed to lead the vanguard. Takatora's forces swiftly entered Kawachi and took up positions between Kō and Koyama. By the time the news reached Sanada Yukimura, who had already entered Osaka Castle, it was evening on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month in the nineteenth year of Keichō.

units.source_en: Tōdō Takatora and Katagiri Katsumoto were appointed to lead the vanguard. Takatora's forces swiftly entered Kawachi and took up positions between Kō and Koyama.

paragraphs.source_zh: 藤堂高虎和片桐且元被任命为先锋，高虎的军队迅速进入河内，在国府至小山一带驻防。消息传到已入大坂城的真田幸村耳中之时，已为庆长十九年十月二十五傍晚时分。

paragraphs.source_en: Just as court nobles and daimyo streamed into Nijō Castle to pay their respects to Tokugawa Ieyasu, rōnin from every corner of the country poured ceaselessly into Osaka Castle. Among them were men who sincerely wished to repay their debt to the Toyotomi, as well as men indifferent to right or wrong who sought only relief from the hardships of earning a living. Yet as this motley multitude continued to swell, it somehow began, almost miraculously, to burn with fighting spirit.

units.source_en: Just as court nobles and daimyo streamed into Nijō Castle to pay their respects to Tokugawa Ieyasu, rōnin from every corner of the country poured ceaselessly into Osaka Castle.
units.source_zh: 正如公卿大名络绎不绝前往德川家康所在的二条城拜谒一样，来自全国各地的浪人亦源源不断拥入大坂城。

units.source_en: Among them were men who sincerely wished to repay their debt to the Toyotomi, as well as men indifferent to right or wrong who sought only relief from the hardships of earning a living.
units.source_zh: 此中，既有欲真正报答丰臣恩义者，也有不问是非、只为解决生计疾苦者。

units.source_en: Yet as this motley multitude continued to swell, it somehow began, almost miraculously, to burn with fighting spirit.
units.source_zh: 如此庞杂之人，伴随着数量的不断膨胀，竟也不可思议地鼓起斗志来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正如公卿大名络绎不绝前往德川家康所在的二条城拜谒一样，来自全国各地的浪人亦源源不断拥入大坂城。此中，既有欲真正报答丰臣恩义者，也有不问是非、只为解决生计疾苦者。如此庞杂之人，伴随着数量的不断膨胀，竟也不可思议地鼓起斗志来。

paragraphs.source_en: On the tenth day of the tenth month, Sanada Yukimura entered Osaka Castle as planned, initially intending to call first upon Ōno Harunaga and propose that they march out to meet the enemy. Now, however, he abandoned the idea. Not one contingent under his command had experience of fighting in the field, and so many men knew nothing even of advancing and withdrawing in formation that he would have to begin by teaching them discipline and commands.

paragraphs.source_zh: 十月初十，真田幸村依计进入大坂城，本想首先拜会大野治长，提出主动出城迎敌之议。可如今，他却放弃了这种想法，因他手中无一队人马受过野战历练，偌多人连战阵进退都一无所知，必须从律令教起。

paragraphs.source_en: Yukimura had never truly intended to fight a decisive battle at Seta, nor was he determined that they must capture Fushimi Castle. He merely wished to drill the troops outside the castle, make them fully aware that this war was bound up with each man's own fate, and then return within the walls to hold them fast.

paragraphs.source_en: This red-clad corps had been formed in imitation of the Ii Red Devils, whose fame had shaken the realm at the Battle of Sekigahara. Everything from the banners and decorative pennants to the armor and helmets was dyed red. Their standard took the form of a Chinese-style hat, magnificent and striking, inevitably recalling Hideyoshi's thousand-gourd standard. Its purpose was largely to make a show of strength.

paragraphs.source_en: Jōkō-in not only came and went from her sister Lady Yodo's quarters, but often visited Ōno Harunaga's camp or held lengthy private talks with Oda Urakusai. Considering her position, there was really nothing remarkable in this. What was suspicious, however, was that she also visited Senhime, Hideyori's wife, with great frequency and had lately even been paying repeated calls upon Okuhara Shinjūrō, who was charged with guarding the inner quarters. Yukimura could not help viewing this with grave suspicion.

paragraphs.source_en: Everyone firmly believed that once they were besieged within the castle, the great warships of Emperor Philip, whom they had never seen, would surely come to their aid. If the great ships came, most of the Tokugawa host would break away. Needless to say, that majority would surely consist of Date Masamune and Matsudaira Tadateru, who acted at his bidding. If those forces changed sides in the midst of battle, could the Uesugi possibly fail to remember their old grievance from Sekigahara? The war would then become a sacred struggle of faith.

paragraphs.source_en: With their ardor for battle blazing so fiercely, what if Jōkō-in persuaded Lady Yodo, sapped the resolve of commander-in-chief Ōno Harunaga, and then drew Oda Urakusai into secret dealings with the enemy? The greatest fear was that while they held the castle to the death, the enemy might suddenly be admitted by someone within. If that happened, everything would come to nothing, and impregnable Osaka Castle would pass into Tokugawa hands in an instant.
